document.pages: p.B8/22 (physical p.22) selection: LADN40 = front clip-on, 4 contacts, 4 N/O, screw clamp; p.B8/79 (physical p.79) scheme 127275.eps terminals 53-54/63-64/73-74/83-84; p.B8/66 (physical p.66) auxiliary contact block characteristics

modelingNotes: LADN40 is a Schneider Electric TeSys D / TeSys D Green front-mounting add-on INSTANTANEOUS auxiliary contact block, clip-on, composition 4 N/O, screw-clamp terminals (base reference). Fits LC1-D contactors.

Manufacturer catalogue spelling is 'LADN40' (no separator). The job/source code 'LAD-N40' inserts a presentation hyphen and 'LAD N40' a space; same reference, recorded here as aliases. orderNumber is kept as the job-provided 'LAD-N40' for identity; the verified manufacturer spelling is LADN40.
Base LADN40 = screw-clamp terminals. Suffix +3 = spring terminals (LADN403), +6 = lug/Faston (LADN406); those are different references and are not modeled here. The job code carries no such suffix.
Terminal marking verified by visual inspection of the exact scheme 127275.eps (p.B8/79): four independent N/O contacts 53-54, 63-64, 73-74, 83-84 (EN 50005: units 3/4 = N/O). No N/C contacts.

All four contacts are mechanically ganged by the host contactor's actuator (they operate together). This coupling is mechanical/functional and does NOT join the contact nets; no factory jumper links any of the eight terminals.
The block has no coil, supply, return, PE/bond, shield or communication connection of its own; the clip-on interface to the contactor is non-electrical.

Ratings are capabilities (conditional), not an assigned circuit voltage, from characteristics p.B8/66: rated operational voltage Ue <= 690 V; rated insulation voltage Ui 690 V (IEC 60947-5-1), 600 V UL/CSA; conventional thermal current Ith 10 A at <= 60 C; frequency 25-400 Hz; min switching 17 V / 5 mA; short-circuit protection gG 10 A. AC-15 and DC-13 operational currents are per-voltage tables (p.B8/68). No scalar terminal rating is asserted.
Contacts are passive and application-dependent; none is universally required. connection_policy 'shared'.

connectionCoverage.notes: All eight terminals of the four N/O contacts are documented from the exact LADN40 scheme 127275.eps (p.B8/79). The accessory exposes no other electrical interface; the clip-on mechanical mount and common actuator are non-electrical.
